map.算例：立式与卧式各一例: Worked example: one vertical case and one horizontal case
map.立式罐 D=4m、L=10m、液位 8m、密度 850、安全 90%：总容量=π:
Vertical tank D = 4 m, L = 10 m, level 8 m, density 850, safe ratio 90%: total capacity = π × (2)² × 10 = 125.66 m³; safe capacity = 125.66 × 90% = 113.10 m³; liquid volume = π × (2)² × 8 = 100.53 m³; mass = 100.53 × 850/1000 = 85.45 t; filling ratio = 100.53/125.66 = 80.0%.
Horizontal tank D = 3 m, L = 8 m, level 1.5 m (= radius, half full), density 750: total capacity = π × (1.5)² × 8 = 56.55 m³; segment area = 1.5² × acos(0) − 0 = 3.534 m²; liquid volume = 3.534 × 8 = 28.27 m³; mass = 28.27 × 750/1000 = 21.21 t; filling ratio = 50.0%.
map.立式和卧式储罐算法有何不同？: How do the vertical and horizontal tank formulas differ?
map.立式罐液面为矩形截面，液体体积=π×r²×液位高；卧式罐液面是圆截面上的弓形，需: A vertical tank has a rectangular liquid cross-section, so liquid volume = π × r² × level height; a horizontal tank has a circular-segment cross-section, so the segment area formula area = r²·acos((r−h)/r) − (r−h)·√(2rh−h²) must be used and then multiplied by the tank length — at half full (h = r) it is exactly half the tank.
map.安全液位/安全容量怎么用？: How are the safe level and safe capacity used?
map.安全容量=总容量×安全充装率(%)；当当前液量超过安全容量会提示「超出安全液位」: Safe capacity = total capacity × safe filling ratio (%); when the current liquid volume exceeds the safe capacity the tool warns that the level is above the safe limit. The setting reserves space for thermal expansion and vapour space and prevents overflow; the actual upper limit depends on the tank type and the medium.
